full_prompt_en: A square vintage sentimental portrait painting brings a rosy-cheeked young girl and a white lamb very close to the viewer against a deep brown background. The girl faces forward with clear blue-gray eyes, a slight gentle smile, and soft light-brown curls framing both cheeks. A pale blush-pink bonnet sits across her head, trimmed with cream lace and a generous fabric bow on the upper right. She wears a simple ivory dress with a rounded scalloped collar, only partly visible because of the close crop. The lamb leans into her left cheek from the lower left, its plush white head, drooping ear, small black eye, and pink nose rendered with affectionate detail. A small peach-colored ribbon or flower at its neck provides a warm accent between the two pale forms. The pair fills almost the entire frame, leaving just enough dark backdrop to define bonnet, curls, and lamb ear. The girl's face is modeled smoothly: warm cream highlights on forehead and nose give way to rose cheeks and subtle gray shadows under the eyes and chin. Fine, soft strokes distinguish the lamb's short wool from the smoother skin and folded cloth. The palette is restrained to ivory, pale peach, warm beige, brown, and small blue-gray eye accents. Light seems to come from the front left, making both faces luminous while the background stays quietly shadowed; no hard cast line interrupts their closeness. The image has the polished softness of an old children's-book illustration or painted studio portrait, with careful edges at the eyes and mouth and gentler transitions in hair and fabric. The composition is tender and symmetrical in feeling, with the two heads pressed together as one calm central cluster.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古抒情肖像画让一名脸颊红润的小女孩和一只白羊羔靠近观众，背后是深棕色背景。女孩正面朝前，蓝灰眼睛清澈，嘴角轻轻微笑，柔软浅棕卷发框住双颊。浅腮红粉软帽横在头上，带奶油色蕾丝边和右上方宽大的布结。她穿简洁象牙白裙子，带圆浑波浪边衣领，但紧密裁切使衣服只露一部分。小羊从左下依偎她左脸，蓬软白头、下垂耳、小黑眼和粉鼻子都被亲切地细描。颈边一点桃色丝带或小花在两片浅色形体之间提供暖点。两者几乎填满整幅，只留足够的深背景分开软帽、卷发与羊耳。女孩面孔塑形平滑：额头和鼻梁的暖奶油高光转向玫瑰色脸颊，眼下与下巴则有轻微灰影。细而柔的笔触把小羊短羊毛与更平滑的皮肤、折叠布料区分开。配色限制在象牙白、浅桃色、暖米色、棕色和少量蓝灰眼睛点缀。光似乎来自左前方，使两张脸都发亮，背景安静地留在阴影中；没有硬投影打断亲密关系。图像有旧儿童书插图或绘制影棚肖像的精修柔软感，眼与嘴的边缘谨慎，发与布的过渡更温和。构图感觉温柔而近于对称，两颗贴紧的头组成一个平静中央簇群。
style_prompt_en: A vintage sentimental painting treatment uses a tight close crop, smooth cream-and-peach modeling, and a dark warm-brown surround to concentrate attention on a joined central cluster. Pale ivory areas occupy much of the middle and lower frame, balanced by soft brown curls and a blush-pink upper accent. Small blue-gray and black points receive the sharpest detail; surrounding clothlike and woolly textures are rendered in short, gentle strokes. Edges are precise at select focal features but feather softly into hair, folds, and dark ground. Front-side light creates luminous rounded highlights, rose-toned midvalues, and mild gray shadows without a hard directional cast. The surface appears carefully painted and slightly aged, neither flatly graphic nor heavily impasto. Background detail is almost absent, allowing proximity and subtle material distinctions to carry the image. The overall rhythm is calm, polished, and affectionate, with warm pale forms held together against quiet darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 复古抒情绘画处理以紧密近景裁切、平滑奶油与桃色塑形、深暖棕色围绕，把注意力聚到合在一起的中央形体簇。浅象牙色区域占据中下部大半，由柔棕卷曲纹和上方腮红粉点缀平衡。小蓝灰与黑点获得最尖锐细节；周围类布料与绒毛纹理由短促温柔笔触呈现。边缘在选定焦点特征上精确，却柔软羽化进卷纹、褶层与深底。正侧光创造圆润发亮高点、玫瑰色中间值与温和灰影，没有硬定向投影。表面显得仔细绘制、略带旧化，既非平板图形，也非厚重堆彩。背景细节几乎不存在，让接近关系与细微材质差异承担画面。整体节奏平静、精致且亲切，暖而浅的形体在安静黑暗前相依。
theme_en: A rosy-cheeked child nestling a white lamb in a Victorian sentimental portrait
theme_zh: 维多利亚式抒情肖像中，一名红脸颊女孩依偎白色小羊
name: Maud Humphrey
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
